subject: english
description: Master the skill of drawing valid inferences from passages and identifying the strongest textual evidence to support conclusions for UPCAT success.
learningObjectives: Draw valid inferences that are supported by textual evidence rather than prior knowledge
Identify the sentence or phrase that BEST supports a given conclusion
Distinguish between inferences, assumptions, and explicitly stated information
Apply close reading strategies to identify implied meaning in complex passages
prerequisites: Understanding of main idea and supporting details
